headline: Burning's final scene featured unscripted falling snow
post:
During the filming of director Lee Chang-dong's dramatic thriller Burning, an unscripted moment of heavy snow began falling as the protagonist walked past a burning car. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the cinematographer shared that the director believes in a "movie god" that only appears after cast and crew put all their energy into the work. The film's violent climax leaves it unclear whether the episode actually happened or was imagined by the character.

Lee's career has deeply influenced many in the South Korean film industry, including Squid Game creator Hwang Dong-hyuk, who noted that watching the novelist become a filmmaker gave him courage to pursue cinema. Possible Love, Lee's new drama, reunites him with actors Sul Kyung-gu and Jeon Do-yeon. The film follows an autoworker left unemployed and damaged after a state-suppressed factory strike, alongside his resourceful wife.

What is your favorite scene in Burning? 🎬

#LeeChangDong #Burning #Netflix
original_title: Lee Chang-dong on the Mysteries and Meaning of ‘Possible Love’

headline: Magneto family tree features complex history
post:
Navigating the extensive family tree of the master of magnetism can certainly be quite confusing. According to Screen Rant, Magneto has an expansive lineage spanning biological children, grandchildren, and extended relatives outside the main continuity. While characters like the Scarlet Witch and Quicksilver were once considered his biological kids, subsequent comic events introduced fascinating retcons to their origins. Yet, Magneto still views Wanda as his daughter and embraces her children, Wiccan and Speed, as his beloved grandchildren. His only currently living canon biological offspring is the X-Men hero Polaris. The Master of Magnetism also shares complex ties with in-laws like the Vision and former son-in-law Quicksilver. Beyond Earth-616, alternate universes feature tragic descendants like Magnus and Charles. Which family connection in the Marvel universe surprises you the most? 

#XMen #Magneto #Marvel
original_title: X-Men: Every Member Of The Magneto Family (And Their Relationship To Its Patriarch)
